title: OppFi Celebrates Financial Capability Month with Release of 2025 Social Impact Report and Expansion of Customer Empowerment Initiatives
summary: OppFi Inc. (NYSE: OPFI) ("OppFi" or the "Company"), a leading tech-enabled digital finance platform that works with banks to provide financial products and services for everyday Americans, is proud to celebrate Financial Capability Month with the release of its 2025 Social Impact Report . The report underscores OppFi's consistent dedication to supporting the 48 million underbanked Americans who lack access to traditional credit. By integrating social impact directly into its core operations, OppFi continues to empower everyday consumers to overcome financial hurdles and build long-term financial stability. "Our Social Impact Report demonstrates OppFi's deep commitment to integrating financial inclusion and financial health as a fundamental part of our platform," said Todd Schwartz, CEO and Founder of OppFi.
